The Babel Registry is the single vocabulary house of the ecosystem; it is not the APP.

BUDGET: 8192.
STATE: vocabulary records; unmeasured = NO_DATA with cause.
SCRUB: figures and paths stay; private names go.
DEPTH: declare your reading depth (0-4) in AGENTS.md before parsing; beyond declared depth is NO_DATA with cause.
REREAD: loaded is loaded; do not re-fetch what you already hold.
AUTHORITY: the Sovereign signs (FIRMO); silicon proposes only.
